artifact_expectations.resume: Reuse every committed batch/chunk; run only missing work; match the cold Rust selection.

cases.name: insufficient_candidates
cases.setup: Request 999 images from the tiny corpus.
cases.expect: Fail with a shortage reason; no completed run.

cases.name: corrupt_payload
cases.setup: After a cold Rust run, truncate one committed assessment JSON.
cases.expect: Reject that hit and recompute its affected dependencies; preserve unrelated checkpoints.

cases.name: missing_media
cases.setup: Remove one cached candidate image after a cold Rust run.
cases.expect: Detect the missing image before use; regenerate only necessary work.

cases.name: wrong_reference
cases.setup: Change one Rust checkpoint reference to the other source at the same PTS.
cases.expect: Reject mismatched content/metadata; never output the wrong source.

cases.name: input_added_moved_count_changed
cases.setup: Add the second source, relocate the input directory, then change count separately.
cases.expect: Reuse each unaffected phase; record recalculation and call counts for each change.

cases.name: inference_changed
cases.setup: Change backend, model, inference level, prompt/schema, media processing or revision separately.
cases.expect: Invalidate dependent results without storing credentials.

cases.name: unowned_output
cases.setup: Place notes.txt and an unknown report in the output directory; request generated context.
cases.expect: Reject before any external call, preserve every byte, and suggest an empty output directory. Search/inference/runtime calls are zero.

cases.name: cache_removed
cases.setup: Remove the Rust cache after a completed run; leave output intact.
cases.expect: Validate ownership from the Rust report and output set without harming images.

cases.name: unsafe_paths
cases.setup: Use symlinks, special files, path traversal or overlapping input/cache/output paths.
cases.expect: Reject unsafe access without changing targets.

cases.name: concurrent_run
cases.setup: Run two processes against the same cache or output.
cases.expect: One owner; the other reports contention and changes nothing.

cases.name: interrupt
cases.setup: Send SIGINT after a committed batch/chunk and separately during extraction.
cases.expect: Exit 130; clean temporary files/children; preserve committed work and previous output.

cases.name: staging_failure
cases.setup: Inject a disk/write failure before publishing a new output set.
cases.expect: Fail and preserve the previous completed output byte for byte.

cases.name: publication_failure
cases.setup: Interrupt after the first publication write.
cases.expect: Detect incomplete/mixed output; recover without reporting success.

cases.name: http_failure
cases.setup: Inject timeout, auth failure, cross-origin redirect or invalid response through mock HTTP.
cases.expect: Finite failure, secret-free diagnostics, preserved completed output.

cases.name: runtime_failure
cases.setup: Fail startup, interrupt inference, then fail cleanup separately.
cases.expect: Protect pre-existing servers; clean only an owned session; retain the primary error.
